summary: This note is a Wikipedia-derived list of the head football coaches of the Cincinnati Bearcats, the football team of the University of Cincinnati. It notes the program's competitive standing in the American Athletic Conference East Division and NCAA FBS, its history of 39 head coaches plus three interim coaches, and periods with no coach or on hiatus. It also identifies Luke Fickell as the current head coach, succeeding Tommy Tuberville.
one_line: Wikipedia list of the head football coaches of the Cincinnati Bearcats, University of Cincinnati's team since 1885.
key_facts: The Cincinnati Bearcats football team represents the University of Cincinnati.
The Cincinnati Bearcats compete in the East Division of the American Athletic Conference (AAC).
The Cincinnati Bearcats compete as part of the NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS).
The Cincinnati Bearcats football program has had 39 head coaches during its existence.
The Cincinnati Bearcats football program has had three interim coaches during its existence.
The Cincinnati Bearcats football program has had one stint with no coach.
The Cincinnati Bearcats football program has had two periods with the program on hiatus.
The Bearcats have been participating in college football since the 1885 season.
The Bearcats were one of the first schools currently in the FBS to sponsor a football program.
Luke Fickell is the current head coach of the Cincinnati Bearcats.
Luke Fickell replaced Tommy Tuberville as head coach.
Tommy Tuberville resigned at the end of the 2016 season.
